Roll & Hero

How to play

Hard to read? Change the theme with the pixel heart next to the cog.

The goal

Reach space 100. Each space plays a video when you land on it.

Your turn

  1. Press Roll dice (R) to move 1–6 spaces.
  2. Watch that space's video to the end.
  3. Wait for the countdown, then roll again (or let Auto roll do it).

Losing

Can't finish a video? Press I lost (Space). You go back to your last checkpoint (1, 25, 50, 75) or the start, and lose your cards.

Cards

At space 1 and every 25 spaces, pick 1 of 3 power-ups. Use them from the item box. White border: one use. Blue: one use, automatic. Red: lasts the whole run.

On the board

Side quests give rewards, ladders climb rows, chests hold a card or an invasion, the merchant sells cards for a video, letters let you choose a side quest, altars trade 4 rounds for any card, and wells give a rest but may drop you a row. All optional.

Keys

R roll · Z accept · X decline · 1–5 items · Space I lost

Main videosThe rounds that play on the board's spaces

Numbered folders

The number in each file's name picks its space: 42.mp4, clip 42.mp4 and my-video-42.webm all play on space 42 (the last number in the name counts). Sub-folders are included.

Several videos for one space? One is picked at random each time. The number next to a folder is its weight: higher means its videos are picked more often. ⏸ pauses a folder without removing it.

Files named by number (like 42.mp4) play on that space.

Unnumbered folders

For videos without numbers. Make a folder here, then add one or more sub-folders to it. Its videos are sorted by length, BPM or both, and spread over spaces 2–99 in that order: short (or slow) at the bottom, long (or fast) at the top.

More than 95 videos? They share spaces, still in order. Checkpoints are left out.

Videos are sorted by length, BPM or both, and spread across the board.

Handpicked groups

For placing single videos by hand. Make a group, add videos to it, then drag each one onto the space you want it on.

They're added to whatever else that space already has, so you can mix them with your folders.

Add videos, then drag each one onto the exact space you want.

Between runs

A run ends when you press I lost or reach 100. With this on, any main video you saw last run is skipped this run, so back-to-back runs don't repeat.

If a space has no other video, it still plays. Checkpoint, invasion, side quest, merchant and reward videos aren't affected.

Stops a video you saw last run from playing again right away when you start another run. If a space has no other video, it can still play.

Special videosCheckpoints, invasions, side quests, the merchant and rewards

Checkpoint videos

These play on spaces 1, 25, 50, 75 and 100 instead of the board's own videos. Name each file with its space number, like 25.mp4 or checkpoint 50.mp4.

With Play checkpoint videos you pass on, a roll that jumps over a checkpoint plays its video first, then the space you land on.

Only for spaces 1, 25, 50, 75 and 100. Name them by number.

Video names must be 1, 25, 50 or 75

Invasion clips

Any videos, no numbers needed. During a round an invasion can cut in, play to the end, then your video picks up where it stopped. Chests can also hold one.

How often they happen and how many per round: Game settings → Invasions.

Clips that can interrupt a video, and that chests can hold. Chance and limits are in Game settings → Invasions.

Side quest videos

Pick the folder with the 7 folders inside.

Side quest folders work differently from the others. Pick one folder that holds 7 quest folders, each with 3 files:

My Quests/
├─ 1 - Princess/
│   ├─ any video file
│   ├─ description.txt
│   └─ reward.txt
├─ 2 - Lost Soul/
│   └─ …
└─ 7 - Phoenix Nest/
  • The number at the start of the folder name decides the quest: its space on the board and its reward (1 = Gold Pendant … 7 = Phoenix Feather).
  • The name after the dash is the quest's title.
  • description.txt is shown before you choose Help or Leave.
  • reward.txt is shown when you finish the quest video, next to the item you win.

On/off and where quests appear are in Game settings → Map objects.

Merchant videos

Any videos, no numbers needed. Land on a merchant and pick 1 of 2 cards: the price is one random video from this folder. Watch it to the end and the card is yours; leave early and you get nothing.

Where merchants appear: Game settings → Map objects.

The merchant plays a random video from this folder as the price of a card. Other options are in Game settings → Map objects.

Reward videos

Any videos, no numbers needed. After space 100's video, one plays at random and I lost turns into I win!. Press it (or Space) when you're done for the winning animation.

With no reward folder, reaching 100 wins straight away.

One plays after you reach 100. While it plays, I lost becomes I win!: press it (or Space) for the winning animation.

CharactersSomeone pops up with a line after good rolls

Every few good rolls (5 or more spaces, or a finished ladder), one of your characters shows up and says one of their lines, picked at random. They can also say something when you reach checkpoint 25, 50 or 75 (their Checkpoints lines; {checkpoint} becomes its number). Write one line per row. Add folder takes pictures with a .txt of the same name (like demon.png and demon.txt): the file name is the character's name and each row of the .txt is a line. In the .txt, rows after a [checkpoint] row are checkpoint lines. Adding the same folder again updates those characters. In a line, {space} becomes your space and {chance} the invasion chance.

SoundVolume for videos and game sounds

Volume

All sounds scales everything. Videos and Game sounds are set on top of it.

100% 100% 100%

Video volume

Makes quiet videos louder and loud ones quieter so they all play at about the same level. The first time a video plays it settles in a few seconds; after that the game remembers its level.

Measures every video you've added ahead of time, so they all start at the right volume the first time. It can take a few minutes; you can keep playing meanwhile.

Videos over 400 MB are measured by listening to short samples spread through them. More samples take longer but get the volume closer. Smaller videos are always measured in full.

Game sounds

Turn each sound on or off. Press ▶ to hear it.

Checkpoint increments: reaching checkpoint 25 adds the amount once, 50 twice and 75 three times (the first checkpoint, space 1, adds nothing). It stays while you're past that checkpoint.

Hot streak: each good roll (5 or more spaces, or a finished ladder) adds to the invasion chance, and each other roll takes one step back off. It drops to nothing when an invasion happens, or when you lose or win.

Map objectsSide quests, ladders, chests, the merchant, wells, letters and altars

Side quests

Quest 1 is on space 10, then 20, 31, 41, 70, 80 and 91, unless you pick random spaces.

Add the quest folder in the menu (cog) under Videos and characters → Side quest videos.

Ladders

Land on the bottom of a ladder to choose: climb (watch the bottom, the space it passes through and the top back to back) or stay.

Chests

Land on a chest and, after that space's video, choose to open it or leave it. Opening shows you a random card to take or leave, plays an invasion clip, or sometimes both (the card first, then the invasion). Opened chests are gone for the rest of the run. Needs Cards on.

35% card · 15% card, then invasion · 50% invasion

Merchant

Land on the merchant and, after that space's video, he shows you 2 cards. Pick one and watch one extra video (a random merchant video) to get it, or leave him. Needs Cards on.

Add the merchant's videos in the menu (cog) under Videos and characters → Merchant videos.

Wells

Land on a well and, after that space's video, you can rest there for 10 seconds. But be careful: after resting you might fall to the row below.

30%

Letters

Land on a letter and, after that space's video, choose 1 of up to 3 side quests you haven't done this run. Finish it to win its reward. Needs side quest videos.

Altars

Land on an altar and, after that space's video, you can make an offering: 4 random rounds back to back, each with a 30% chance of an invasion. Finish all 4 and pick any card in the game. Needs Cards on.

CardsPower-up cards at space 1 and every 25 spaces
19 of 19 on

Click a card to stop it from being offered. Type a weight under a card: 5–10 common (white glow), 3–4 rare (blue glow), 1–2 super rare (purple glow). The % is its chance to be in each 3-card pick. White cards are used once, blue cards are used once automatically, red cards stay for the run.

What's in a game preset
  • Saved: wait between rolls, auto roll and checkpoint saving; repeating captions, speed changes and their alarms; invasions; side quests, ladders, chests, merchants, wells, letters and altars; cards (on/off, which are off, their weights).
  • Not saved: your folders and videos (cog menu), where you are on the board and your items this run. Where map objects sit is saved only with Save object positions on.
DeveloperTest tools

With dev mode on, click any space on the board to move there or to add and remove chests, merchants, wells and ladders. Click the item box under the board to give yourself any card or side quest reward. Every hero is open to try while dev mode is on. Nothing counts: videos aren't marked as watched or remembered for the next run, and records don't change.
